card.name: Science news and citations of journals
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation in research-news or citation text, especially around journal names like Lab on a Chip, and in lab or device descriptions.

modes.label: Journal citations
modes.description: Small words or periods just before or after a journal title or reference entry.
modes.example: Findings also have been recently published in two peer-reviewed journals, Lab on a Chip<< and>> Microfluidics and Nanofluid

modes.label: Lab and procedure descriptions
modes.description: Connecting words in descriptions of lab devices, samples or dental preparation steps.
modes.example: First the porcelain veneer will be cleaned<< and>> prepared for the cementation process.

card.writes: It pushes down tokens starting with G, such as Good and GL, and promotes odd name fragments, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in science news and reference lists, especially near journal names.
